title: AJ Styles vs. Okada
summary: AJ Styles arrives with Bullet Club and treats Okada as the inexperienced wrestler he once knew. Okada must reclaim his championship and force Styles to recognize the Rainmaker’s standing.

chapters.title: Styles wins with an inside betrayal
chapters.result: Styles defeats Okada for the IWGP championship.
chapters.context: Yujiro turns against his CHAOS ally and assists Styles, adding faction betrayal to the title loss.

chapters.title: Okada ends Styles’ second reign
chapters.result: Okada defeats Styles to win the championship.
chapters.context: The Rainmaker regains the belt in Osaka, answering the opponent who had dismissed his development.
